name: Finance policy review
description: Task templates for finance teams reviewing internal policies. Answers cite only documents the person may open.

templates.title: Travel receipt rules
templates.request: When are travel expense receipts due, and what happens if they are late?
templates.desired_output: A short answer for staff, with citations
templates.style: Answer in at most three short sentences, plain language, no headings.

templates.title: Expense approval limits
templates.request: Who must approve expense claims above the standard limit, and what are the thresholds?
templates.desired_output: A table of thresholds and approvers

templates.title: What changed in the policy
templates.request: Which parts of the finance policies changed between the two latest versions, and what should the team review?
templates.desired_output: A list of changes with the old and new wording cited

evaluation_cases.question: How long do I have to hand in my trip receipts?
evidence: Travel expense receipts must be submitted within 30 days of the end of the trip. Late submissions need a manager's note.

evaluation_cases.question: Who signs off a very large expense claim?
evidence: Expense claims over 1,000 euros need approval from a director in addition to the line manager.
The office is open from 08:00 to 18:00 on working days.

evaluation_cases.question: What is the price limit the board set for the takeover?
evaluation_cases.expect: No source you are allowed to open
